d: Long, flowing jet black hair with straight bangs and a small ornamental hairclip on the left side. Sharp, almond-shaped eyes of a vivid crimson shade, paired with a youthful and mature face. A slender build, dressed in a white kimono-style top with wide sleeves and red trim, worn over a short, pleated red skirt and black thigh-high stockings with red bands. Around the waist is a dark grey ammunition belt with multiple pouches, and a gold cord is pinned to the chest.
